questions.question:
What will come in the place of the question mark (?) in the following equation, if ‘+’ and ‘×‘ are interchanged and ‘−’ and ‘÷’ are interchanged?

51 ÷ 6 + 9 × 84 − 4 = ?
questions.solution:
Given: 51 ÷ 6 + 9 × 84 − 4 = ?

‘+’ and ‘×‘ are interchanged and ‘−’ and ‘÷’ are interchanged.

Here, we use the BODMAS table given below:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2040eaffb074fd42b592cdae119c98b95e1a291a924e7e0c4209b3005a60fec5.png] 

51 - 6 × 9 + __**84 ÷ 4**__ = ?

51 - __**6 **____**×**____** 9 **__+ 21 = ?

51 - 54 + 21 = ?

72 - 54 = ?

18.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 2"**

questions.question: The position(s) of how many letters will remain unchanged if each of the letters in the word ACTIVITY is arranged in reverse English alphabetical order?
questions.solution:
Given word: 'ACTIVITY'

After arranging in reverse English alphabetical order:

 
 

 Alphabets
 A
 C
 T
 I
 V
 I
 T
 Y
 
 

 Reverse alphabetical order
 Y
 V
 T
 T
 I
 I
 C
 A
 
 

 

The alphabet "**T**" and the alphabet "**I**" remain unchanged when the letters in the word 'ACTIVITY' are arranged in reverse English alphabetical order.

Hence, the correct answer is "**Option 4**".

questions.question: A, B, C, D, E, F and G are sitting around a circular table facing the centre (but not necessarily in the same order). B sits third to the right of E. E sits second to the left of G. G is to the immediate right of F. G is not an immediate neighbour of E. A sits on the immediate right of B and C sits on the immediate left of E. How many people sit between D and B when counted from the left of D?
questions.solution:
A, B, C, D, E, F and G are sitting around a circular table facing the centre (but not necessarily in the same order).

 
• B sits third to the right of E.
 
• E sits second to the left of G.
 
• G is to the immediate right of F.
 
• G is not an immediate neighbour of E.
 
• A sits on the immediate right of B and C sits on the immediate left of E

The Final Arrangement is,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bf1618ca5f7fadde80a54f71ff6034575fb2ef3064e6e6684607d500a5ae1c60.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1"**

questions.question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusion(s) logically follow(s) from the statement(s). '

Statements:

All onions are potatoes.

No potato is a tomato.

No potato is a corn.

Conclusions:

(I) No onion is a tomato.

(II): Some corns are tomatoes.
questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8b84c9867135d0d9f52be075c302304b4acd88480d0b4a815e418440aa841e3e.png] 

Conclusions:

(I) No onion is a tomato. - True (As their is no relation potato and tomato and all onion is potato. So no onion is a tomato is true.)

(II): Some corns are tomatoes.- False ( As their is no relation potato and tomato and all onion is potato. So no onion is a tomato is true.)

Only conclusion (I) follows.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3"**
